facts.fact: 多里安死讯公开举丧：家门钉上月桂、系黑丝带并挂上黑绉纱；弟弟 Maxim 已把丧仪布置妥当。
facts.quote: A laurel fastened to the entry of my home, a black ribbon to present my mourning.

facts.fact: 棺木外部刻有亡夫多里安的 Nova 与 Eclipse 两个出生星记，以及家人挑选的 Everie 符号。
facts.quote: The outside inscribed with his Nova and Eclipse birth signs, then symbols from the Everie

facts.fact: 多里安的母亲（Lucia 的婆婆）居首排抿嘴，其妹 Clara 坐在旁边；Lucia 的母亲随后推着父亲（Papà）入场。
facts.quote: My mother-in-law, front and center, pursed her lips. Dorian’s sister, Clara, at her side

facts.fact: Lucia 致悼词：她是梦想家、多里安是让梦想落地的双手，并承诺今后无论做什么都为他而做。
facts.quote: I was the dreamer; he was the hands that made it happen.

facts.fact: 关键转折：棺中多里安面容撕裂、眼球几乎脱出眼窝，Lucia 当众尖叫，被弟弟 Maxim 扶住。
facts.quote: Dorian’s face, his eyes wide open and white. His face torn, eye barely back in its socket.

facts.fact: Lucia 再次走近棺前，多里安面容已变成毫无凹痕划伤的铜色死亡面具，宾客无人相信她所见。
facts.quote: Dorian’s face was fashioned with a death mask of copper

facts.fact: 野兽以人形混入吊唁宾客，打扮得像 Fairfax 家的亲戚；额上星记只有 Lucia 认出，他还向她眨眼示意。
facts.quote: he blended in seamlessly, like he could be related to the Fairfaxes

facts.fact: Maxim 建议 Lucia 找医生就诊，在名片背面抄下号码塞到她手里，要她承诺去预约，她答应了。
facts.quote: I’m going to call a friend. I want you to make an appointment
